about: Champions registry of the RL project (decided by Jakob, 25 Nov 2026, #166). Promoted versions, best first: the newest promotion is on top. rl-gate's default opponents are entry 0 (the current champion, the base being challenged), entry 1 (the previous champion) and the fixed anchor greedy-full-probe-perf (the frozen greedy champion, never changes, whatever this list says; greedy-full-probe until 26 Nov 2026), shuffled over the opponent seats per seed. Until an RL version is promoted, entry 0 is greedy-full-probe-perf, so two opponent seats are greedy-full-probe-perf (see iteration0). Add an entry only with `rl-gate promote <id> --gate <PASS gate JSON>`, after a PASS and its merge; older entries stay listed for history. kind: greedy-model (a bot model under models/) or, later, rl-policy (an RL policy; not playable as an opponent yet, see `Opponent` in engine/gate/src/main.rs).
rule: Jakob, 26 Nov 2026 (#166): two lists. rlLine = the RL versions, best last-promoted first: RL v1 enters by decision once it plays complete games; every later version must pass rl-gate with --base = rlLine[0]; greedy models never decide an RL pass. champions = the opponent list (entries 0 and 1 fill the champion and previous-champion seats): greedy until the first head of rlLine passes rl-gate with --base = champions[0]; from then on each new head of rlLine is promoted here too. The anchor greedy-full-probe-perf (engine/gate/src/main.rs) never changes. Details: docs/rl-project/README.md, 'RL versions and the opponent list'.
seeded: 25 Nov 2026 with the three strongest greedy models by the Elo tournament of 25 Nov 2026 (elo/2026-11-25/README.md: Bradley-Terry over 145,350 games), which are also the last three greedy champions in order of promotion: economy (experiment 10) -> combo (11) -> probe (12). Perfection ratings with 95% intervals: greedy-full-probe 1742 (1711 to 1772), greedy-full-combo 1635 (1612 to 1659), greedy-full-economy 1617 (1596 to 1637); the same three places overall (1902, 1791, 1767). Entry 1 (the previous champion, an opponent seat) is therefore greedy-full-combo: the champion probe was tuned from, and #2 in every mode. greedy-full-economy is listed for history only (not an opponent).
iteration0: 26 Nov 2026 (Jakob, #166): before the first RL iteration the two Perfection-tuned greedy models of experiment 17 head the list, and the anchor in engine/gate/src/main.rs is greedy-full-probe-perf. greedy-full-probe-perf passed rl-gate against greedy-full-probe (mean +176, better on 53.5% of differing seeds). greedy-full-combo-perf is entry 1 by Jakob's decision, not by a gate PASS (it is even with probe: +16, gate FAIL, where untuned combo was -415): the previous-champion seat should be Perfection-tuned too. Entries below them are history. They stay the opponents until an RL version beats the greedy champion (see rule).

set as previous champion by Jakob (26 Nov 2026), not by a PASS: rl-gate vs greedy-full-probe FAIL but even (mean +16, 50.4%; untuned combo -415); greedy-full-combo tuned by a perturbation probe in Perfection, Continents, Crazy
